name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2014 (Data for Calendar Year 2013)
description:
This dataset contains New York City building energy and water benchmarking data disclosed under Local Law 84 for calendar year 2013, released in April 2014. Each row represents a property, with identifiers such as property ID, NYC building identification number, borough-block-lot, address, and geographic details including borough, latitude/longitude, community board, council district, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area. Building characteristics include year built, floor area, number of buildings, occupancy, and primary property type (self-reported and EPA-classified).

The core content covers annual energy performance: site and source energy use and energy use intensity (EUI), weather-normalized values, ENERGY STAR scores and certification dates, and comparisons to national medians. Fuel-specific consumption is broken out for electricity, natural gas, fuel oils No. 2, 4, and 5/6, and district steam, alongside greenhouse gas emissions (total, direct, indirect, and net), green power purchases
